name: Mikami Yuu
source:
A third-year who's rumored to be an "onee" based on the feminine way he talks.

His looks and general aura make it hard for his underclassmen to get close to him.

He reluctantly agrees to help the heroine out, but......

"Since I'm helping you, I don't want to see any sloppy work, got it?"

(Translated from official website)
